finding: The fixed 60s reserve is an experimental guard, not yet an empirically estimated close-overhead percentile. Previous 14m evidence records close 88s after nominal target, but that 88s includes post-target work plus finalization and therefore must not be equated with close_overhead_sec.
measurement_requirement: For this and later probes, distinguish target overshoot from pre_close_ts-to-close_end_ts whenever practical. Do not inflate safety margin solely from target overshoot.
